relationships.subject: BW-031
relationships.evidence_quote: identified one, BW-031 (Figure 1a), as a compound that inhibited Nav1.7 sodium channels with substantially higher potency than QX-314 when applied intracellularly

relationships.subject: BW-031
relationships.evidence_quote: Intracellular BW-031 also inhibited heterologously-expressed Nav1.8 channels (Figures 2c,d) but with greatly reduced potency compared to Nav1.7 and Nav1.1 channels

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: BW-031 can permeate through activated TRPV1 channels to block sodium channels from the inside of the cell.

relationships.subject: BW-031
relationships.evidence_quote: BW-031 inhibited inflammatory pain in all three models tested

relationships.subject: BW-031
relationships.evidence_quote: BW-031 strongly inhibited the citric acid-induced cough in a dose-dependent manner

key_findings: BW-031 is a charged Nav1.7/Nav1.1 blocker about 6-fold more potent than QX-314 intracellularly, entering via activated TRPV1 channels.
BW-031 alone inhibited inflammatory pain in rat CFA, incision and mouse UV burn models and reduced cough in guinea pigs.
